headline: Full-time work at 85.7 % clearly exceeds both benchmarks, though branch totals stay hidden.
how_to_read: Flows run from all respondents (left) to employed or not employed (middle) and then to detailed situation (right); width is the share of respondents. Branch totals are hidden, so they show as lower bounds (≥) and a hatched "Hidden" flow leaves "Respondents" directly.
key_findings: Nobody reports not seeking work, studying, retirement or another situation; seeking work is hidden (fewer than 3 people).
benchmark: Full-time work is 11.1 pp above Asia (74.6 %) and 10.8 pp above all schools (74.9 %). Asia's employment total is 91.3 %, but this school's total is hidden and cannot be compared.
caveats: With n = 28, each person moves the percentages by several points, and both totals are hidden.
